etymology: a primitive root [identical with 07788 through the idea of going round for inspection]
avSummary: behold 5, see 4, look 2, observe 2, lay wait 1, regard 1, perceive 1
definition:
1) to see, behold, observe, regard
    1a) (Qal)
        1a1) to behold, observe
        1a2) to regard
        1a3) to watch, watch (stealthily), lie in wait
